 LeBron James Injury Update, Latest on 76ers Star's Status vs. Nets
 Paul Kasabian Nov 16, 2026 Philadelphia 76ers forward LeBron James won't play against the Brooklyn Nets on the road on Monday night. 
 Per the Associated Press , James will miss the second half of the 76ers' back-to-back as he manages his low back and sciatica injury. 
 Ahead of James missing Monday's contest, ESPN's Dave McMenamin reported that the veteran "has asked coaches to be patient with him as he expects to find his rhythm and get his conditioning in line by December as he ramps up."

 Bleacher Report 2d James missed his team's 123-112 home win against the Toronto Raptors on Nov. 12 because of the same injury .
 He previously sat a pair of games on Oct. 25 and Oct. 31 . Of note, both matchups were part of back-to-back sets. The designations were injury management for low back pain/sciatica.
 James missed the first 14 games of the 2025-26 NBA season, when he was a member of the Los Angeles Lakers, with sciatica on his right side .
 The 41-year-old is playing in his 24th NBA season. The four-time NBA MVP and four-time NBA champion has averaged 15.1 points, 7.2 rebounds and 6.9 assists in 11 contests for an 11-3 76ers team fighting for the top spot in the Eastern Conference in the early going.
 James has obviously played an integral part in the team's early success. Without him, the 76ers have turned to Dean Wade to join the starting lineup.
